models.yolox-s: Lightweight option. Fixed 640px RGB input and 80 COCO categories. Favor this model when throughput or memory matters; it is not identity or open-vocabulary recognition.
models.rtdetr-v2-r18: Balanced, relatively small RT-DETRv2 R18. Fixed 640px input and 80 COCO categories. The existing default remains unchanged; choose a larger model explicitly when desired.
models.yolo26-l: Accuracy-oriented YOLO26-L. Fixed 640px input with an NMS-free export; more compute than lightweight models. AGPL-3.0 applies to these Ultralytics weights.
models.yolo26-x: Higher-compute YOLO26-X. Larger than L; intended for users prioritizing detection quality over scan speed. Fixed 640px input, not a guarantee of better results on every photo. AGPL-3.0 weights.
models.rf-detr-large: Accuracy-oriented RF-DETR Large with the current 704px contract, not the legacy 560px model. ImageNet normalization and sparse COCO output slots are adapted to the common 80-category index. Apache-2.0 weights.

ai_models.test_persistence_hint: Save and test saves parameters and credentials before running the model. A failed test does not undo that save. Online tests still require upload confirmation.
ai_models.unsaved: Configuration has unsaved changes. Background refresh keeps your input; switching or closing asks first.
ai_models.discard_draft: Model configuration, credentials or an import manifest have unsaved/unimported changes. Discard them and continue?
ai_models.replace_manifest: Loading a template replaces the unimported model manifest. Continue?
ai_models.download_license_confirm: {model} uses {license}. Its code and model-weight licensing differs from Apache-2.0; review the applicable terms before redistribution or integration. Continue downloading?
ai_models.title: AI models
ai_models.intro: Choose one global model per task. All libraries share the selection; each model keeps its own parameters.
ai_models.key_saved: Stored securely; leave blank to keep it
ai_models.cloud_warning: Online inference sends text and resized images to this provider and may incur charges. Keys are not stored in JSON.
ai_models.cloud_consent: Allow this model to send images and text to the configured service
ai_models.background_consent: Also allow automatic library indexing through this provider (bulk uploads and API charges)
ai_models.rebuild_parameter: Changing this parameter rebuilds derived results
ai_models.save_hint: Saving parameters does not switch models. Use the global selector or activation button to switch. Inference tests run the model; online tests send two requests.
ai_models.import_hint: JSON manifests specify an existing adapter, complete artifact set, HTTPS download URLs and SHA256 checksums. Unknown architectures need a new adapter.
ai_models.test_cloud_warning: This test sends sample text and a synthetic image to the configured service. API charges may apply. Continue?
ai_models.reset_warning: Use this model globally? Incompatible automatic AI results will be rebuilt. Human-confirmed people, names and face annotations are preserved; regions whose source files changed require review. Original media files are not modified.
ai_models.delete_confirm: Remove this inactive custom model and its configuration? Downloaded model files will not be deleted.

parameters.gpu_device_id: Provider device ID (-1 = auto; see DirectML adapter details)

ai_models.rebuild_confirm: Rebuild the affected automatic AI index? Human-confirmed face labels and people are preserved. Original media files are not modified.
ai_models.contract_verified: Saved model configuration: inference contract verified
ai_models.contract_untested: Saved model configuration: not tested. Online models must pass the image/text inference test before use.
ai_models.gpu_hint: Auto tries available acceleration then CPU, with a reported reason. Explicit GPU selections never silently switch to CPU. Some operators, preprocessing and clustering may still run on CPU. Inference tests show real operator placement.
ai_models.global_hint: Select a model to configure it below. Ready models switch globally after validation and any required confirmation. Models awaiting download or API setup can be configured first without changing the active model.
ai_models.physical_detection_incomplete: Physical GPU identities could not be fully confirmed. Available inference backends can still be used; unverified logical adapters are not counted as physical GPUs.
ai_models.adapter_hint: Multiple adapter IDs may refer to one physical GPU. DirectML device IDs use these numbers; CUDA device ordinals are independent.

face_actions.offline: Some selected originals are unavailable. Reconnect them before face detection.
face_actions.redetect_confirm: Re-detect only these selected images? Overlapping faces keep their existing person assignments; obsolete face regions in these images will be removed. Original files and people in other images are not deleted.
face_actions.finished: Face job complete: {faces} newly detected faces, {cached} cached images reused, {failed} failed images.
face_actions.cancelled: Face job cancelled; committed detections are preserved.

face_editor.edit_label: Edit a name or correct face recognition
face_editor.title: Edit / correct face result
face_editor.assign_existing: Assign this face to an existing person
face_editor.assign_new: Create a new person for this face
face_editor.rename_hint: This updates the person's name in every photo. To correct one misidentified face, change its assignment instead.
face_editor.single_face_hint: Only this face region is affected. Other faces, existing person names and original photos are unchanged.
face_editor.name: Person name
face_editor.no_results: No people found. Refine the search or create a new person.
face_editor.unassign_hint: This is a real face. Only remove its current person assignment and retain it as manually unassigned. Other faces, names and person records are unchanged. You can also assign it to the correct person.
face_editor.not_face: False positive: this region is not a face
face_editor.confirm_hint: Save this region and person as a human-confirmed annotation, preserved across model changes.
face_editor.ignore_hint: This is a real face, but you do not want to organize it yet. Hide the region and retain the ignore decision. Restore it in People → Face review → Ignored / False positives.
face_editor.not_face_hint: Hide this false-positive box and record the region as not a face. Re-detection of the same file filters overlapping detections. Restore it in People → Face review → Ignored / False positives. Photos and people are not deleted; this does not train or fine-tune a model.

face_review.leave_confirm: Switching or closing clears your selection and unsubmitted operation. Continue?
face_review.updates_pending: New results are available. Your selection and edits are preserved; refresh after finishing your review.
face_review.refresh_confirm: Refreshing clears your selection and unsubmitted batch operation. Continue?
face_review.title: Face review
face_review.scope: All faces in the current library, independent of the selected album or person. Human confirmations are stored separately from automatic suggestions.
face_review.stale_hint: These annotations belong to a changed source file and will not be applied to its new content. Detect and annotate the current image again; the original human record is retained.
face_review.restore_hint: Restored regions become unassigned. Old identities and model vectors are not restored automatically; you can assign a person again.
face_review.confirm_action: Apply "{action}" to {count} selected faces? Rejected assignments stay unassigned during automatic clustering. Ignored/non-face regions can be restored from their category.
face_review.person_scope: Only faces assigned to this person. Moved faces appear under their new person or the library-wide unassigned category.
face_review.batch_hint: Only selected faces move; whole people are not merged. All selected faces join one new person when creating an identity.

person_merge.title: Merge people
person_merge.hint: Choose a target and preview first. All source faces and historical annotations transfer while keeping the target name. Original media and model vectors are not rewritten.
person_merge.confirm: Merge “{source}” into “{target}”, moving {count} current face records.
person_merge.history: Also transfer {count} existing human annotations, including changed-source history.
person_merge.warning: Source identities will be removed and assignments will point to the target. There is no one-click undo; an incorrect merge must be split by selecting faces manually.

thumbnail_rebuild.title: Regenerate thumbnails
thumbnail_rebuild.folder_scope: Regenerate thumbnails for indexed images in this folder.
thumbnail_rebuild.safe_hint: Only derived caches change. Originals, tags and face annotations are untouched. Offline files are skipped; decoding failures retain previous caches.
thumbnail_rebuild.cancelled: Stopped. Completed thumbnails are retained; remaining files were not processed.
thumbnail_rebuild.offline: Original files are unavailable; thumbnails cannot be regenerated.

face_diagnostics.title: Face detection diagnostics
face_diagnostics.thresholds: Detection threshold {detection} · Quality threshold {blur} · Detector input edge {size}
face_diagnostics.summary: Images {imageCount} (cached {cachedImages}) · Detected faces {detectedFaces} · Quality filtered {qualityFiltered} · Annotation suppressed {annotationSuppressed} · Stored regions {storedRegions} (manual {manualRegions}) · Failed images {failedImages}
face_diagnostics.toast: Face task: {detectedFaces} detected, {qualityFiltered} quality filtered, {annotationSuppressed} annotation suppressed, {storedRegions} regions stored, {failedImages} images failed. Details are available in People.
face_diagnostics.explanation: Detected faces passed confidence threshold and NMS. Stored regions may include earlier human annotations, not newly detected faces. Thresholds and matching behavior are not changed automatically.
face_diagnostics.face_sample: Face {index}: confidence {confidence}, quality {blur}, region {width} × {height} px, result: {state}
face_diagnostics.quality_hint: The detector found a face, but the app filtered it below the quality threshold. Resolution, compression and texture affect this score; this is not a detector miss.
face_diagnostics.annotation_hint: Detections overlapping human ignore/non-face regions were suppressed. Restore them in Face review → Ignored / False positives. Re-detection preserves human decisions.
face_diagnostics.heic_hint: If HEIC previews show corruption, AI may receive incorrectly decoded pixels. Check the preview and try regenerating thumbnails. Decode/inference failures are not reported as no-face images.
face_diagnostics.cached_hint: {count} scanned images reused existing results without running the detector. Re-detect for fresh diagnostics.
face_diagnostics.omitted: {count} additional image details omitted; all images remain in aggregate counts.
face_diagnostics.raw: Diagnostics (no images, vectors or credentials; check local paths before sharing)
face_diagnostics.force_saved: Face region #{id} saved. Name or assign it in People or on the face box.
face_diagnostics.force_hint: Confirm quality-filtered faces individually. Only the selected region bypasses sharpness; detector confidence and human exclusions still apply. The confirmed region survives future scans without changing global parameters. Blurry features may reduce matching accuracy.
face_diagnostics.force_stale: Candidate location information is missing, or the source/model changed. Re-detect this image before confirming.
face_diagnostics.force_excluded: This region was manually ignored or marked not a face. Undo that decision first; confirmation does not bypass it.
face_diagnostics.force_busy: Inference or a library operation is running. Finish or stop it before retrying.

person_management.cover_hint: Choosing a cover confirms this face’s identity and preserves it across rescans and model changes.
person_management.cover_unavailable: No face preview is available. Regenerate this photo’s thumbnail first.

map_services.title: Maps and location services
map_services.description: Choose map display and reverse geocoding independently. Saving updates all map windows without silently switching vendors.
map_services.service_scope: Choose display and location services independently. AMap/Tencent display uses official SDKs; photo GPS stays WGS84.
map_services.existing_locations_hint: Geocoding uses a separate Web service Key, not a JS Key. Saved administrative levels are shared by all location views; switching providers does not re-resolve photos. Resolve old photos from Locations. Offline nearest-place names are not guaranteed to be localized.
map_services.custom_hint: URLs require {z}, {x}, {y}; optional {s} and {token} are supported. Attribution is plain text. Follow your provider’s copyright and caching terms.
map_services.web_key_hint: Use a Web Service / REST API key, not a JavaScript SDK key. Tencent also needs the SK if signature checking is enabled.
map_services.public_token_hint: Use a Mapbox Public Access Token starting with pk. Style owner and IDs are configurable.
map_services.auto_import: Resolve locations online when importing or refreshing metadata (off by default; may slow scans and incur charges; failures use offline results).
map_services.privacy: Online resolution sends coordinates to the selected service, never photos. Switching does not bulk rewrite existing locations; resolve individual photos in their information panel.
map_services.proxy_hint: Tiles and address requests use the application proxy in General. Offline location lookup needs no network; map display is still online.
map_services.saved: Saved and applied to map windows
map_services.gps_placeholder: GPS is (0,0), a suspected placeholder. Address resolution and nearest-city guesses are skipped; original GPS is unchanged.
map_services.no_address_result: {provider} responded without a usable detailed location (levels below country or a formatted address). The previous address is retained; other photos continue.
map_services.response_status: Response: HTTP {http} · API status {status} · API code {code}
map_services.response_fields: Returned fields: address component {component} · formatted address {address} · administrative levels {levels}
map_services.coverage_advisory: This point is outside the GCJ02 conversion reference bounds. Verify coverage for this endpoint/account or try another geocoder. This is a coverage advisory, not proof that AMap cannot resolve any overseas locations.
map_services.tile_error: Map tile could not be loaded

fields.sdkStyle: SDK style (AMap URI / Tencent style ID, optional)

map_services.sdk_hint: Display requires a JavaScript Key, plus securityJsCode for AMap. Web Service keys are for geocoding only. Authorize this application’s domains. Browser proxy changes require an app restart. Only unauthenticated HTTP/SOCKS5 proxies are supported; older macOS builds should use the system proxy.

location_batch.title: Resolve locations in bulk
location_batch.alias_hint: Labels come from saved addresses. By default, successful results for the current provider and unchanged GPS are skipped. Empty addresses do not stop the batch.
location_batch.library_scope: All photos with valid GPS in this library
location_batch.safe_hint: Only structured addresses and the location tree change. Originals, EXIF, GPS, faces and tags are untouched. Failures retain saved addresses; excluded folders are skipped.
location_batch.consent: I agree to send the selected photos’ GPS coordinates to this online service; requests may consume API quota.
location_batch.placeholder_skipped: Also excluded {count} photos with suspected (0,0) placeholder GPS; no address request was sent and they do not count as failures.
location_batch.skipped: Skipped {count} photos according to the selected mode.
location_batch.remaining: {count} photos remain unprocessed. Continue them or retry failures separately.
location_batch.automatic_stop: Stopped after five consecutive service or storage errors. Check the network, proxy, Key or quota before continuing or retrying failures.
location_batch.finished: The selected range is complete. Failures can be retried separately; photos without valid GPS were excluded.
location_batch.cancelled: Stopped. Completed results are retained; remaining photos are unchanged. An in-flight request may take up to 15 seconds to stop.

smart_albums.recognition_incomplete: Indexing is incomplete. Empty results do not prove that photos contain no matching text or objects.
smart_albums.recognition_confirm: Run {task} with the current global model for the current library, not just this smart album? Completed results are kept; models are not downloaded or switched automatically.
smart_albums.preview_required: Preview AI results before saving to calibrate this model and threshold.
smart_albums.folder_delete: Delete this virtual folder? Its contents will move to the parent. Original files will not be changed.
smart_albums.anniversary: On this day in previous years
smart_albums.prompt: Describe the photo content (English is recommended for CLIP)
smart_albums.incomplete: Results are incomplete until AI indexing finishes.
smart_albums.analyse_confirm: Analyse missing photos with the current semantic model? Online models send photos to their provider. You can stop the task; completed results are kept.
smart_albums.reindex: Indexing is not running; use Analyse missing photos to continue or retry.
smart_albums.move_invalid: Cannot move a folder into itself or its descendants.

templates.recent_picks: Recent month: three stars or better

media_lifecycle.partial_failed: {count} operation(s) failed; see Recently Deleted for the retained recovery record.
media_lifecycle.move_confirm: Move these hidden originals to Recently Deleted? Their hidden state and metadata are retained; restoring keeps them hidden.
media_lifecycle.title: Media types
media_lifecycle.privacy_hint: Hidden photos are excluded from normal browsing, search, maps and smart albums. This is not file encryption.
media_lifecycle.trash_hint: Originals are retained in .lap-trash on their album disk, with catalog metadata. Nothing is automatically expired. Restore does not overwrite existing files.
media_lifecycle.hide_confirm: Hide these photos from normal library views? Their originals and metadata are preserved; Hidden is not an encrypted vault.
media_lifecycle.purge_confirm: Permanently delete the selected registered recovery files? This cannot be undone. Files outside the recovery area will not be deleted.
media_lifecycle.processing_warning: An interrupted operation is recorded here. Try Restore; originals or recovery copies are kept.
media_lifecycle.classification_hint: Classified only from explicit frame information or metadata. Unsupported evidence stays unclassified. Rescan existing albums to populate categories.

media_recovery.backup_scope: This backup contains databases, configuration and recovery journals, not original or .lap-trash media files. Back up the album disks separately.
media_recovery.review_required: Recovery metadata needs review; automatic file operations are disabled.

private_viewer.readonly: Read-only; visibility and deletion state stay unchanged. Local decoding only; no uploads. Arrow keys navigate, wheel or ± zoom, 0 resets.
private_viewer.cache_only: Showing only a cached thumbnail; this does not confirm the original is available.
private_viewer.no_preview: No preview available. Review the diagnostics above and retry.
private_viewer.no_thumbnail: No cached thumbnail; try opening the original
private_viewer.local_decode_failed: The local browser cannot display this original; online decoding was not attempted.
private_viewer.cache_failed: The cached thumbnail cannot be displayed either.

private_lock.title: Private area app lock
private_lock.checking: Checking private access. No media is loaded before authorization.
private_lock.locked: Hidden and Recently Deleted are locked. Enter your password to unlock.
private_lock.cooldown: Too many attempts. Retry in {seconds} seconds.
private_lock.not_encryption: An app lock only restricts in-app access. Originals, databases and caches are not encrypted and remain accessible in the file manager.
private_lock.current_password: Current password (required to change or disable the lock)
private_lock.new_optional: New password (leave blank to keep the current password)
private_lock.on_blur: Lock when the main window loses focus
private_lock.scope: Applies to every library. Restarting, leaving the private area or switching libraries requires unlocking again. Keep the password safe; it cannot be retrieved. This is not file encryption.
private_lock.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.

media_restore.title: Restore photos and companion files
media_restore.rename: Keep both at original locations (one suffix per group)
media_restore.directory: Restore to a chosen directory (one suffix per group on conflict)
media_restore.path: Full destination path inside a registered album
media_restore.registered_only: Choose an existing album root or enter an existing subdirectory. Cross-disk recovery is supported. Add unregistered directories as albums first; no new scan root is created automatically.
media_restore.safety: No strategy overwrites files. RAW/JPEG, Live Photo video and sidecars are restored together, preserving IDs, ratings, tags, collection membership and manual face annotations.
media_restore.resume: This group has a durable restore plan. Retry continues that plan; new options do not change a group that has already started.
media_restore.valid_only: Restore only the {count} groups that passed preflight. Failed groups remain available for retry.
media_restore.recheck: Preview does not move files. Paths are checked again before execution. New conflicts can change the suffix of an unstarted group or stop recovery; no destination is overwritten.

media_jobs.title: Background media tasks
media_jobs.stage_waiting: Waiting for another media operation to stop safely
media_jobs.stage_cancelled: Stopped; unfinished items can be retried
media_jobs.stopping: Stopping safely; completed file groups will not be rolled back
media_jobs.private_hint: Unlock Hidden or Recently Deleted to view detailed errors or retry registered recovery groups. Successful items are not repeated; details show at most the first 200 failures.

ocr.correct_line_hint: {text} · Click to edit or ignore this line
ocr.discard_draft: Text revisions have not been saved. Discard these changes?
ocr.smart_hint: Uses valid results for the current global model, with human edits taking priority. Text does not contain applies only to recognized results, not pending or failed photos. Albums update as recognition and edits complete.
ocr.smart_text_placeholder: Enter text to match in photos
ocr.auto_hint: Global opt-in. Processes pending photos in idle batches and yields when any application window is used. No model downloads or automatic failed-item retries. Manually stopping pauses automation.
ocr.auto_library_scope: Scope: visible photos in the currently open library
ocr.auto_yielded: Yielded to user activity. Completed results are saved; recognition resumes when idle.
ocr.edit_hint: Edit or ignore lines. Human edits are stored separately, survive model changes and re-recognition, and never modify the photo. Ignored text is excluded from search.
ocr.edit_stale: The photo, model or recognition changed. Preserve any draft you need, then reopen the editor to avoid overwriting newer results.
ocr.reset_manual_confirm: Remove human edits for this photo and use the current model result? Recognition is needed if that model has no result. The original photo is unchanged.
ocr.region_drag_hint: Drag to select a text region. Press Esc to cancel.
ocr.region_temporary: Temporary by default. Merge selected text as a manual correction to make it searchable after saving, without replacing whole-photo results.
ocr.manual_drag_hint: Drag a box over missed text, then type it. Nothing is indexed until saved.
ocr.manual_only: Manually added text; no whole-photo model result was used.
ocr.no_new_lines: The selected text already exists or its boxes are invalid. Adjust the selection and retry.
ocr.region_too_small: The region is too small. Select a larger area.
ocr.region_busy: OCR is busy. Stop the current task first.
ocr.preview_pending_hint: The current photo no longer matches this filter. To avoid interrupting the preview, the list will sync when you change photos or leave preview.
ocr.search_hint: Searches recognized text only. Unprocessed photos have no text results.
ocr.setup_hint: Download and enable an OCR model to begin. Existing results remain available.
ocr.profile_hint: Counts and results use the current model configuration. Changing models may require recognition again.
ocr.stopped_saved: Stopped. Completed results are saved; continue to process remaining photos.
ocr.no_results_hint: Try another status or clear the text search. Recognize unprocessed photos to make them searchable.
ocr.select_photos: Select photos or RAW images for text recognition.
ocr.reidentify_confirm: Re-recognize the selected photos with the current model? Existing results for this configuration will be replaced.
ocr.task_started: Text recognition started. Progress is available in Image text.
ocr.locate_hint: Click a line to locate it in the photo.
ocr.geometry_hint: Preview proportions differ or the result lacks image dimensions. Text boxes are hidden to avoid incorrect positions. Use a matching preview or recognize again.
ocr.quality_hint: Mobile/Server are model sizes, not device restrictions; both run locally on PC. Prefer PP-OCRv5 Server for quality-first desktop use; keep Mobile as a smaller, lower-resource option. Server is not an online service. Evaluate quality on your own photos.
ocr.device_hint: Automatic prefers GPU by default. Configure detection and recognition devices above. Sessions below show the actual devices used after loading. Automatic CPU fallback reports a reason; explicit GPU failures remain errors.
ocr.local_hint: Local processing of normally visible photos only. No uploads or hidden/deleted media. Use the regular search box to find indexed text.
ocr.download_first: Download an OCR model in the model catalog first.
ocr.rebuild_confirm: Recognize all normally visible photos again? Results are replaced per photo; originals remain unchanged.
ocr.limits: This adapter targets horizontal/upright Chinese, English and Japanese text. Handwriting, artistic text, slanted text and complex layouts are not guaranteed. Model/parameter changes require the corresponding index. Stop takes effect after the active inference returns.
ocr.photo_hint: Uses the saved global OCR model on this device only. View background progress in Image text or the task notification.
ocr.not_indexed: This photo has not been indexed with the current model.
ocr.empty: Indexed; no text met the confidence threshold.

model_download.completed: Model downloaded, verified and installed. Select and activate it above.
model_download.cancelled: Download cancelled. Incomplete files are not marked as installed.
